notes.title: "Halluci Sabbat of Koishi" Full Version Released!
notes.notes:
After two and a half years of early access experience, I am honored to tell everyone:
[h2][i][b]"Halluci Sabbat of Koishi" Full Version Released Today！[/b][/i][/h2]

This is an important step we have taken and the most significant update for this game, but it is by no means the last update.
[h3][b]I don't want to call the current version the complete version, because the two main bosses I planned, "Marisa" and "Seiga", are not presented to players in their entirety.[/b][/h3]
Despite many imperfections, this adventure of Koishi has finally come to a successful conclusion. We would like to say thank you to all the players who participated in the early access experience!
[b]Borrowing a Koishi's dialogue:：[h3]“The more we pursue perfection, the more we will lack. If you have already tried your best, there will be no regrets. If you cannot reach the final agreement, achieving half of it is also an achievement!”[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/d336a89af8fda4e987e2d222ab668cca56632b2e.jpg[/img]
Although it's a bit like what Black Myth producer Feng Ji said, and we did go through rush work, cutting content, and hiding waste cases, we ultimately tried our best to finish this imperfect answer sheet. I've already done my best, so there's nothing to regret~

If you like our game, please recommend it to your friends around you. This is probably more awesome than buying this game~!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/ad3408008570efeb253e11b352113aea8799adb5.jpg[/img]

[i][h3][b]Producer's Words[/b][/h3][/i]
我是制作人 零教授。[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/7a3e5d0c2b1bb23d6dcb8ba64fa667d5bf0ff378.png[/img]
在开发这部作品的过程中，虽然主要过程都是我一个人在那搓代码和攒素材，但是受到了不分国籍的同好们的协助。
他们有的是愿意为恋恋赋予甜美灵魂的配音演员；
有的是鼎力添笔的画师和动画师；
有的是跨越国籍语言鸿沟提供协力的日本同好；
有的是群里数量庞大愿意尽其所能贡献绵薄之力的测试小伙伴。
以及用众多销量让游戏的点数商店大获成功的衣食父母——玩家们！

感谢有这样一群同好众人拾柴，我一个人的开发工作才不会过于压抑和乏味。毕竟单人开发过程中没有其他组员跟你交流和讨论，闭门造车真的是很难坚持下去呢（笑）。[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/906c5fd09e3b58162bfc9c52f2cdf3618e40513f.png[/img]
原先本作是为《东方恋迷踪》筹集开发经费，因为光是完成试玩版的前两章半的内容就几乎耗尽了我毕业后的存款（笑）。
本作最初也只设定了10个关卡以及只有这些蘑菇们作为BOSS，极度小品级的横版过关游戏。
不过在一些喜欢本作的小伙伴的怂恿下，把关卡数扩大到了现在的30余个，并且加入了越来越多的东方BOSS（比如有小伙伴发现1-4的位置突然被可爱的三月精占领了呢~）
三妖精关卡几乎是在半个月之内爆肝爆出来的呢~ 努力制作新内容就是我对玩家们热情的最大的回馈~！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/2dc93205893e3db4e4224822825c487fbf278c42.jpg[/img]
虽然魔理沙和青娥还是因为老问题饼画太大而难产，但是你们等着，她们很快就会带着华丽地弹幕向各位袭来的~
[i][h3][b]帮《东方恋迷踪》筹集开发经费的任务，本作也圆满，且超额完成了！[/b][/h3][/i]

[i][h3][b]About the new work[/b][/h3][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609270

Therefore, we will start working on 'Touhou Koi-Mystery' immediately this year. Friends who have been looking forward to this work for a long time can also rest assured!
The game 'Touhou Koi-Mystery' will still feature magnificent barrage performances, exquisite CG, a large number of uniquely designed enemies, point shop items filled with in-game avatars on Steam, and other things that everyone wants to see~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/78e632a5aacaf75c9b5c8a7e15595c5eb5092988.jpg[/img]
Due to the use of a new engine in the production of 'Touhou Koi-Mystery', early next year, when the system construction is basically completed and the progress is basically on par with the trial version, I will release a new trial version that can be reviewed for everyone to try!

There may also be plans for DLC linking with other works in 'Halluci Sabbat of Koishi', please stay tuned~

[h2][i][b]We will complete the production of the new boss for 'Halluci Sabbat of Koishi' as soon as possible. We hope everyone will enjoy and promote this game. Thank you again！[/b][/i][/h2]

If there are any bugs, please feel free to raise them and we will fix them as soon as possible~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/708ce2037c916e8e374e120638bd4cd06d5b6cd5.jpg[/img]

Oh, by the way, I need to thank all the artists for their strong support of this game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/e228ecdc2b5ba304bfc496824111ba654f39fdc2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/870d09ec53f72db5d8c8391fe1eebd7138173175.jpg[/img]
Looking forward to seeing more and cuter Koikoko~The Koikoko candy in this game hopes that everyone will have enough to eat!

notes.title: 幻恋夜宴10000销量突破!! 预定5月14日转正式版! 10000 Sales ~ Full version released on May 14th！
notes.notes:
各位车友各位恋厨小伙伴们新年好呀~
这里是零研主催 零教授 啦
在这里首先祝大家新年快乐，新的一年车万同人越办越好~
我们制作的古明地恋横版类魂游戏《幻恋夜宴：恋恋的幻觉夜宴》在新年期间已经[h1]突破了10000销量[/h1]！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/d86716d8f71090f8eb3378285e12c0244359acc4.png[/img]
在这里感谢大家的踊跃支持与好评！
视频中会有详细介绍↓↓↓
[previewyoutube=grTadNqfUP0;full][/previewyoutube]
大家有没有攻略新更新的三小只BOSS呢~ 非常闹腾根本停不下来

东方x类魂是小众x小众的题材，这部作品能有现在的成绩，与诸位的捧场分不开关系。毕竟只狼这部令人畅快淋漓的武侠巨作却是魂系列里卖的相对偏少的

然后，在今年的[b]5月14日[/b]前后，《幻恋夜宴》将结束EA，转为[b]正式版发行[/b]！
然后[b]涨价到35￥（8.99 $）[/b]

在过去两年的开发中，我们陆续制作了诸如长爪蜈蚣 峰云、仙峰寺四猴、双石像鬼、幻影之蝶、宫内破戒僧等强力BOSS来供大家挑战

只要再完成苇名流 佐濑甚助、归树看门犬、恶兆王 蒙格特 以及剑圣 苇名一心这4位BOSS，游戏便能以完全体与大家见面了。
届时欢迎大家再战心中强敌。233

期间社团还会制作以琪露诺为主角的轻量级小游戏，但是国区玩不到所以就不在这里介绍了。
并且，在5月完成《幻恋夜宴》的时间节点，[b]《东方恋迷踪》的开发也将揭幕[/b]。

《东方恋迷踪》使用Unity进行全新开发，制作琪露诺的小游戏也是为了熟悉Unity的基础代码与模块设计。
拥有全新引擎带来的高品质优化，可以在保留旧恋野迷踪的系统的基础上，全方面升级游戏的画面效果以及内容，比如恋恋将不再单打独斗，而是拥有会自动战斗的队友参展。装备系统和战斗伤害系统也全部重做啦~

那么更多内容还敬请期待，以及Steam上的东方恋迷踪DEMO，是会进行更新的，大家可以在DEMO的页面下到最新版本的测试版内容哦~

下面就请大家欣赏，由画师们倾力支持的《幻恋夜宴》一万销量贺图~
所有的以及后续的贺图会放入游戏的CG画廊中，供大家欣赏。

此外，三妖精的动态壁纸也会加入游戏中~

notes.title: Regular update 20240126- Three Fairies of Light
notes.notes:
Regular updates for 20240126, version number Ver.0.9.6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/bab7934ab53fb6124bc62ccaffe697ea0968ac2d.png[/img]
[b]【Main Update】[/b]
Completed the level of March Essence, including BOSS stage, plot, and achievements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/ff99330d595c3608c107f9f5a451faa690456d74.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/24134277725aafca5c42fa86b8acfbbd97bf43dd.jpg[/img]
The three fairies are ending the beginner's tutorial in 1-4, waiting for newcomers.
The three stage rune card, the geocentric theory of the three fairies, is a beautiful and dreamy ball shaped barrage battle like an observatory, believed to leave a stunning impression on everyone.

It can also be seen as a preventive shot for future bosses, allowing new players to adapt to the rhythm of the game in advance.

To this end, two new features have been updated: pseudo Penglai mode and unconscious automatic combat AI

[b]·pseudo · Penglai mode[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/ec4b9ffb6ca483cdc1717ceeb479c59ffceab760.jpg[/img]
The infinite resurrection mode that can be enabled in the settings interface. If you encounter a strong enemy (such as Kokoro) that cannot be defeated even with reduced damage, you may want to turn on this infinite resurrection switch. Although you cannot obtain achievements, by familiarizing yourself with the enemy's attack mode, you can more easily pass the level with one life on normal difficulty to obtain achievements.
In addition, using this mode to clear levels, after obtaining attribute bonuses, it will be easier to switch back to normal mode to clear the second or heart eye levels.

[b]·Unconscious automatic combat AI[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41015409/506f255743cd9db4cd591cfa9058dbf2e7b6f2f7.jpg[/img]
The automatic combat AI romance that is only enabled in the first stage of March Precision Battle on normal difficulty helps beginners familiarize themselves with the game's defense and attack rhythm.

The key to the game is to press the defense key or attack key at the right moment. AI can accurately read Sonny's instructions, and shake and press the defense key before or after Sonny's attack. If you have no knowledge of the game's combat system, observing AI training to familiarize yourself with learning can be a good method.

The following are other updates:

1. Kokoro windmill adds vacuum wave special effects;

2. Fix the health limit curse texture error;

3. The liberation of the id will not play BGM every time;

4. The March level can unlock reincarnation;

5. The attack power and intelligence of the menu page are increased by icons to indicate which ones are HP and which ones are energy points

6. Added a large number of beginner guides, including an AI that automatically controls relationships;

7. Replace the cover of levels 1-4;

8. Rebirth of love increases the rose effect;

9. Fix the issue of Shannu's defeated CG occupying the unlocked CG position

10. Bugs in other corners

Thank you all for your support~
